_why: The house entrance, and the one a beat should almost never have to override: a short fade under a slightly longer, barely-there zoom. Subtle enough to sit under every element in the bank without reading as an effect.
_measured: Not measured off a reference: these are the durations motion design uses at 30 fps (150 ms = 5 frames, 250 = 8, 400 = 12, 600 = 18), chosen off the effects sheet rendered 2026-09-13. A verdict on the sheet replaces them.
